annotation_description_on_image: two white star symbols marking sites of steric clash between EMCV IRES and 60S subunit
from_the_caption: Closeup view on a steric clash between the EMCV IRES and the 60S subunit.

annotation_description_on_image: white star next to on-image text label 'Clash', with a red X over the blocked reaction arrow
from_the_caption: On the right, formation of the 80S complex is prevented by a steric clash between the 40S-bound EMCV IRES (red) and the 60S subunit.

annotation_description_on_image: black line/arrow with on-image text label 'Met-tRNAi Met' pointing to the initiator tRNA
from_the_caption: Zoomed-in view of the ribosomal positioning of initiator tRNA bound to the EMCV IRES and eIF2α in 48S initiation complexes.

annotation_description_on_image: black line/arrow with on-image text label 'Met-tRNAi Met' pointing to the initiator tRNA
from_the_caption: Close-up of the ribosomal positioning of initiator tRNA and eIF5B in 40S ribosomal complexes in the process of subunit joining.

annotation_description_on_image: yellow star with on-image distance label '16.7Å' marking the shift in tRNA position
from_the_caption: Superimposition of (H) and (I) showing a 16.7 Å shift in the position of tRNA, which leads to...

annotation_description_on_image: yellow star connected by a line to on-image text label 'C548' marking the site of steric interference
from_the_caption: ...steric interference between the tRNA T-loop and the C548 residue of the EMCV IRES tetraloop-containing subdomain after eIF2 is replaced by eIF5B, disrupting the stable tetraloop-tRNA contact.
